coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset). Azeliragon is given in both arms (Arm 1: adjuvant phase only; Arm 2: neoadjuvant and adjuvant); Arm 1 is registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but still receives azeliragon, so azeliragon is coded experimental_monotherapy (the only investigational agent) rather than control_comparator. Role of azeliragon in the registered-comparator arm differs in timing only. Radiotherapy, surgery and LITT are not agents.
